rtpc.sync_hold: fade every stem except box to −inf over 0.15 s and mute tick; restore on release
rtpc.shave_bonus: strings stem +4 dB while shave_bonus = 1 (Boost Lv3)
rtpc.break: play sfx/combat/break_gong_vinyl and duck all stems 6 dB for 0.4 s

mus_battle_core_u0.notes: Hook = Crono's cell up an octave as crotchets, the C held 300 ms (0.72 beat) too long. Box = Time cell at half speed.

rtpc.sync_hold: fade every stem except box to −inf over 0.15 s and mute tick
rtpc.shave_bonus: pad stem +4 dB while shave_bonus = 1 (Boost Lv3)
rtpc.hitstop: the war drum (drums stem) only on hitstop: play drums at −inf and open it for 0.3 s on each hitstop if the U1 night rule is wanted

mus_battle_core_u1.notes: Same skeleton as U0: shakuhachi scoops into the hook, koto −12 cents, taiko pitched down a minor third and saturated.

rtpc.phase: phase 1 = intro+A, phase 2 = bridge+B (12 fps VHS), phase 3 = coda (gold leaf at bar 25); use AudioStreamInteractive clips per section
rtpc.grief_resonance: not used here; Robo is not Vaelos

mus_boss_atrium_cradle.notes: Ceramic tings side-chain the other stems to 0.2 for 0.2 s. B gates the quartet at 12 Hz and bit-crushes it.

rtpc.translucency: strings stem (the voices): 100 → −12 dB, 0 → +3 dB; below 50 add the Debt bus chorus (up to 7 voices)
rtpc.slip: on a slip play the harp stem reversed (AudioStreamPlayer pitch −1 is not available: use the reversed section clip from the bridge)

mus_sera_theme.notes: Harp cell E5 B4 D5 B4 E5 (a palindrome: the bridge states it reversed and it sounds the same). Shamisen reversed per bar.

mus_stings_defeat.notes: Tape stop over 0.4 s at 1.15 s, then a porcelain crack and shards as the Debt advances.

mus_stings_overcap.notes: A VHS whine (2.4 → 3.1 kHz with flutter) and a tracking snap. Never a fanfare.

mus_stings_victory.notes: The Time cell resolving onto C major with whatever tines remain (render variants with missing tines by the same generator).

rtpc.save_loaded: replace box with box_debt60 / box_debt20 according to the save's porcelain integrity

mus_title.notes: Through-composed 100 s, then the loop region is the coda: box alone over hiss. Loop lands on bar 40.

rtpc.heartbeat: pitch_scale the whole bed with the heartbeat RTPC (72 → 1.0, 144 → 1.4) or layer sfx/time/chronoslip
rtpc.camera_fov: a slip widens the FOV and muffles everything except this heartbeat: music bus low-pass 400 Hz

mus_transit_chronoslip.notes: No music: brown-noise thermals, a 76 BPM chest heartbeat, a rubber-hose Doppler whoosh every 11–16 s. Seamless 64 s loop at −23 LUFS.

rtpc.chase: follow-up: a chase stem of tachyon chirps (sfx/magic/tachyon_travel at 1/8th notes)
rtpc.telepod: at the Telepod detune the band: pitch_scale 0.97 and the Debt bus chorus to 7 voices

mus_u0_fair_1024.notes: 6/8 scored at the quaver (324/min, 6 per bar); felt pulse 108. World cell in E Dorian on the fiddle.

rtpc.stir_ritual: the stirring is quantised to the beat (3.333 s bar); when Crono stops stirring, skip the crackle stem 0.5 s forward (the house clock skips)

mus_u0_guardia_morning.notes: World cell at pitch (D4 F4 A4 G4 E4) in F major; the crackle stem carries the house clock at 72 BPM.

rtpc.crono_hp: 100% → full mix; towards 20% fade lead and drums to leave bass + box (the hollow marrow pulse)
rtpc.breath: side-chain the bass stem to Crono's idle breath (duck 3 dB on each exhale)
rtpc.porcelain_stress: swap in a box stem with more missing tines (not rendered: use wind_scene box_debt60/20 as the model)

mus_u0_truce_1024.notes: Shamisen bent 15 cents flat with a slow wobble; 808 decays 2.2 s; the box is already missing its B4 tine.

rtpc.porcelain_stress: swap the box stem: >60 → box, 21–60 → box_debt60, 1–20 → box_debt20, 0 → box_debt0 (the tape stops at 15.2 s); above 60 also fade in the debt stem
rtpc.glow_intensity: box and tick stem volume: 0 → −12 dB, 100 → +2 dB with saturation
rtpc.gate_proximity: not rendered: layer sfx/status/vhs_fog (U2 gramophone hiss) or a CRT hum near gates
rtpc.vaelos_near: layer mus_vaelos_theme__pad (68 BPM heartbeat) under this track

mus_u0_wind_scene_1024.notes: Tick: 12 quavers per 2-bar phrase, the 8th is a silent click (the missing tooth) so the C4 lands without its tick; mainspring grind every 4 bars from the loop start. Loop region = A+Bridge+B+Coda.

rtpc.movement: ink-stroke swells on movement: play sfx/weapons/krona_nodachi gesture layer at −18 dB on each run start
rtpc.silence: the track is quiet by design (−12 LUFS short-term peaks only on the taiko); do not normalise it louder

mus_u1_ashen_morning.notes: 48 BPM, 5 s bars. World cell on A (A4 C5 E5 D5 B4) with meri scoops. Taiko every two bars; washi crackle at −50 dB.

rtpc.smear: the 24 fps smear: a 0.3 s reverb freeze is rendered at the bridge → B seam (35.0 s); at runtime use AudioEffectReverb with room 1.0 for 0.3 s
rtpc.hitstop: duck the mix 6 dB and play sfx/combat/break_gong_vinyl on hitstop

mus_u1_krona_duel.notes: Krona's cell G C D E♭ at pitch over a D pedal (Phrygian bruise). Taiko pitched down a minor third and saturated.

rtpc.grief_resonance: pad stem volume and the Sub bus: 28 Hz → −6 dB, 40 Hz → +3 dB; also opens the music low-pass to 800 Hz
rtpc.vaelos_near: lay bass + pad under any world track (they phase at 68 against the hub's 72)
rtpc.heartbeat: the pump is fixed at 0.8 Hz here; U8 drives it from the RTPC

mus_vaelos_theme.notes: Bassoon C2/G♭2 on every beat with a sub octave; tenor hum = Crono's cell even and clean, −50 cents; pump 0.8 Hz; drone 28–40 Hz.

ambience.notes: Fracture wind with a thin whistle, the chest heartbeat at ~72 BPM, a far glass crack every ~20 s.
Wind through the Horologe, the fair across the water, the 72 BPM tick with its missing tooth; bells at 14 s and 46 s, gulls, Robo's eye chirp.
Fire roar under silence, washi crackle, heat shimmer; the temple bell at 9 s and 52 s, crows, banners snapping.
